exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Planning a Day in London
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Emma
transcript.text: So, where should we start our day in London, Tom?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Let's begin near the river. London is an ancient port city with a long history.

transcript.speaker: Emma
transcript.text: Great. Can we see Tower Bridge first? People say it's a symbol of the city.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Of course. After that, we can visit the National Gallery to see the paintings.

transcript.speaker: Emma
transcript.text: Wonderful! But first I need to get my phone charged. The battery is almost dead.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: No problem. There's a café nearby where you can charge it.

transcript.speaker: Emma
transcript.text: Perfect. Then let's keep our eyes open for the historic sites along the way.

exercises.translation_cn: Emma 和 Tom 商量在伦敦怎样开始一天;Tom 建议从河边开始,因为伦敦是历史悠久的古老港口城市;先去看作为城市象征的塔桥,再去国家美术馆看画;Emma 想先给手机充电,Tom 说附近咖啡馆可以充;然后一路留心历史古迹。

questions.stem: Where does Tom suggest starting their day?
What does Tom say about London?
options: It is an ancient port city.
It is a very small town.
It is far from the river.

questions.stem: What is Tower Bridge said to be?
Why does Emma need to stop first?
What will they do along the way?
options: Look for a car park only.
Keep their eyes open for historic sites.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 The Names of the UK
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many people are confused by the different names for the UK.
In the 16th century, Wales was joined to the Kingdom of England.
Later, Scotland and then Ireland were added.
In the 20th century, the southern part of Ireland broke away.
Today most people simply use the shortened name, the UK.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多人被英国的各种名字弄糊涂;16世纪威尔士并入英格兰王国;后来苏格兰、再后来爱尔兰也加入;20世纪爱尔兰南部脱离;如今大多数人就用简称 the UK。

questions.stem: What confuses many people?
options: The different names for the UK.

questions.stem: Which country was joined to England in the 16th century?
What happened in the 20th century?
options: The south of Ireland broke away.

questions.stem: What name do most people use today?
In what order were the countries added?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Traditional Village Pub
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: This village pub looks so old and cosy. Is it part of a tradition here?

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text: Yes, the pub is at the heart of village life. People come here to meet friends.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: What should I try? I'd love to taste something traditional.

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text: You must try the beef stew. And many people enjoy a glass of wine or a local beer.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: That sounds lovely. Is there music too?

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text: Yes, sometimes there's traditional music and dancing in the evening.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: How wonderful! It's a great way to experience the local culture first-hand.

exercises.translation_cn: Lily 觉得乡村酒馆古老温馨,问这是否是当地传统;Jack 说酒馆是村庄生活的中心,人们来这儿见朋友;推荐 Lily 尝炖牛肉,还有人喝葡萄酒或本地啤酒;晚上有时有传统音乐和舞蹈;Lily 觉得这是亲身体验当地文化的好方式。

questions.stem: What does Jack say the pub is?
options: At the heart of village life.

questions.stem: What traditional food does Jack suggest trying?
What drinks do many people enjoy there?
What sometimes happens in the evening?
options: There is traditional music and dancing.

questions.stem: How does Lily feel about the pub?
options: It's a great way to experience local culture.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Four Groups in British History
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Four groups of people took over Britain at different times.
The Romans came first and built many towns and roads.
Then the Anglo-Saxons introduced the beginnings of the English language.
The Vikings left behind new words and many place names.
Finally the Normans conquered England and changed the legal system.
exercises.translation_cn: 四群人在不同时期先后占领了英国;罗马人最先到来,修建了许多城镇和道路;接着盎格鲁-撒克逊人带来了英语的雏形;维京人留下了新词和许多地名;最后诺曼人征服了英格兰并改变了法律制度。

questions.stem: How many groups took over Britain?
What did the Romans build?
What did the Vikings leave behind?
What did the Normans do?
options: They conquered England and changed the law.

questions.stem: Who introduced the beginnings of English?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Back from Pingyao
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I've just come back from Pingyao, and it was amazing!

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Oh, I love Pingyao! Did you walk along Ming-Qing Street?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Of course, but I didn't expect to see so many tourists there.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I know what you mean. But the snacks on that street are wonderful, aren't they?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: They really are. I also climbed the old city wall. It was like walking into history.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Did you visit the famous family courtyard as well?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes, but it wasn't as big as I had expected. Still, the whole trip was great fun.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 刚从平遥回来,觉得很棒;Ben 也爱平遥,问她有没有走明清街;Anna 走了,但没料到游客那么多;Ben 说那条街的小吃很棒;Anna 还爬了古城墙,像走进了历史;问她有没有去著名的家族庭院;去了,但没她想的那么大,不过整趟旅行很有趣。

questions.stem: Where has Anna just come back from?
What surprised Anna on Ming-Qing Street?
What does Ben say is wonderful on that street?
How did Anna feel on the old city wall?
What did Anna think of the family courtyard?
options: It was the biggest she had seen.
It wasn't as big as she had expected.
It had no rooms at all.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 British Afternoon Tea
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Afternoon tea is an old British tradition that many families still enjoy.
People usually add a little milk to their tea.
They often eat small snacks such as cakes and sandwiches.
Friends greet each other warmly and sit down to chat.
It is a relaxing way to share time and keep an old custom alive.
exercises.translation_cn: 下午茶是许多英国家庭至今仍喜爱的古老传统;人们通常往茶里加一点牛奶;常配蛋糕、三明治等小点心;朋友们热情地相互问候、坐下闲聊;这是分享时光、让古老习俗延续下来的轻松方式。

questions.stem: What is afternoon tea?
What do people usually add to their tea?
What small snacks do people often eat?
What do friends do at afternoon tea?
options: They greet each other and chat.

questions.stem: Why is afternoon tea special, according to the passage?
options: It costs a lot of money.
It keeps an old custom alive.
